I managed to wrestle my Toyota Corolla to a stop without crashing and sat there, heart pounding, as I wondered what to do next. It was 1982 in Canberra; a foggy, bitterly cold night in the middle of winter. I was wearing a silly flapper dress and high heels – I’m not sure I’d even packed a jacket!
